body:
Concentrated findings round (maintainer-directed, 2026-08-13): **promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`** (`domain:spec-tooling` unchanged — the disposition taxonomy and its gate predicate are the machine face of the spec contract). Type: Task.

Grading rationale: the re-litigation cost is concrete (every future published-runtime-interface PR re-derives the #8277 argument by hand or mis-generalizes it), and the fix is well-scoped: one named category in the ADR-0087 disposition + one grep-shaped predicate in the changeset gate, with the #8277 review thread as the worked example to encode.

Dispatch notes: the ADR half makes the PR ADR-class (draft/push/open is fine; merge is the maintainer's). Recommend ONE PR carrying both halves so the predicate and the category text cannot drift apart at birth — the whole PR then simply waits for the human merge; split only if the maintainer asks. The predicate must encode #8277's actual argument (touched exported symbol appears in no `*.zod.ts`, no `contracts/**` entry, no object definition), not the looser "no metadata ⇒ exempt".

Size/model suggestion: M, `mode:subagent`, opus (fable only if the gate predicate turns into real gate-semantics design).

Claim: `domain:spec-tooling` PM seat, session `session_01WocN37om5bw81JDoEEMA2e`.

- Branch: `claude/issue-8299-runtime-interface-disposition`
- File surface: `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (the `CATEGORIES` vocabulary and whatever verifies each category) + `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` (the disposition text), plus the gate's self-test. One PR carrying both halves, per triage.
- Container & model: `mode:subagent`, M, model `claude-opus-5`. Fable clause considered and **not** triggered: this adds a disposition category and a mechanical predicate, but it neither grows a published API surface nor changes what the *spec* accepts — it changes what a **gate** demands. ⚠️ If the dev's measurement turns the predicate into real gate-semantics design (as triage flagged), that is a report-back, not a silent escalation.

**Premise re-verified at dispatch on `origin/main`:**

- The disposition vocabulary is **closed and three-valued** — `CATEGORIES = ['unpublished', 'already-registered', 'no-migration-prescription']` at `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:208`, whose own comment says "Adding a category is a deliberate act."
- The ADR text lives at `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`. Its ratified-exemption section (`:361`) is about the majors 12–15 launch window — a different exemption from the one this card is about; do not conflate them.
- The gate already checks four dispositions "against facts rather than taken on trust" (`:120`), which is the shape the new category's predicate must match rather than invent.

**⛔ Landing is human-merge.** The PR touches `docs/adr/**`, so this seat will review it and leave it hanging visibly for the maintainer — ⛔ never `ready`+auto-merge, never queued. That is stated up front so the dev does not read a non-merge as a rejection.

**Serial constraint:** no lane card holds `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` or the ADR right now. ⚠️ #8360 (finding, ungraded) concerns the same registry family's merge behaviour but touches neither file.

Checkout fast-forwarded to `89e9808` before dispatch, per the runbook clause added in `720fe14` (subagent-mode dispatches load agent definitions from the local checkout, not `origin/main`).

PM review of PR #8456. **Accepted as the deliverable; ⛔ NOT merged — ADR-class, awaiting the maintainer's own merge.** Both open questions are ruled here; neither goes to the decision box.

**① "Judge the claim that was made" vs "infer every touched symbol" → A, as shipped.** Not close on any axis, and the decisive one is that B is the cross-package retirement detector the maintainer's 2026-08-07 ruling deliberately routes *around*. A's failure mode is an incomplete claim a reviewer can see in the marker; B's is a gate red for reasons nobody can act on — which is how gates get worked around. `registered` already judges the claim rather than the diff, so A is also the consistent shape. If B is ever wanted it is its own card with its own falsification, not a rider.

**② Documenting the whole vocabulary in the ADR, not just the new category → A, as shipped**, even though it is a larger ADR edit than the card literally asked for. The card's complaint is that there was no named category *to cite*; adding one to a record that describes none of its siblings would still not be citable. And A is what makes the two-way `assertInputs` pin possible — the mechanism that stops this card recurring. Recorded as a **declared out-of-surface increment**, and it lands in front of the maintainer by construction.

**Verified independently, not taken from the report** (`origin/main`):

- The homonym is real and the card's proposed predicate really would refuse its own worked example: `PackagePublishResult` is declared twice — `packages/services/service-package/src/index.ts:76` (the interface #8277 changed) and `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.zod.ts:166` (`z.input<typeof …>`). A bare name is not a symbol identity in this repo; `path#Symbol` is the correct correction, and turning that collision into the accept/refuse fixture is better than a synthetic one.
- The ADR merge-approval gate's red is the gate working: its own header requires an approving review on any `docs/adr/**` diff **and** forbids an armed auto-merge. Both halves are why this seat will not clear it.

⚠️ **Correcting my own claim comment**: I repeated the card's framing that "the disposition text lives with ADR-0087". Measured false — the vocabulary existed *only* in the gate; `grep -i 'disposition\|changeset' docs/adr/0087-*.md` returned nothing before this PR. That is not a detail: it is why ② was the right call.

Worth the maintainer's eye when reviewing: **#8277's exemption was held by a detector MISS, not by a finding** — `findMigrationPrescription` returns `null` on its real changeset even though the body does prescribe the migration in prose. The dev correctly did not file that as a defect (the gate's header documents that residue deliberately, with its own 131/20 measurement), and it is the strongest argument that this category was worth naming rather than left to prose.

Card stays `pm:dispatched` while the PR is open — ⛔ the label is not swapped back on an unmerged ADR-class PR, and the PR is not queued.
